data.name: Language_Description
data.value: Choose the language used by the grid.

data.name: SortOrder_Description
data.value: Bind the integer column used to persist row order.

data.name: ParentLookup_Description
data.value: Bind the child-table lookup that references the current parent. The parent ID is resolved automatically in model-driven subgrids where runtime context is available.

data.name: EditableColumns_Description
data.value: Optional comma-separated logical names allowed for editing; when empty, writable columns are determined from table metadata.

data.name: CopyExcludedColumns_Description
data.value: Comma-separated logical column names to omit, e.g. hky_externalid,hky_note. Leave blank to copy all creatable fields. Primary keys, autonumbers, alternate keys and computed fields are excluded automatically. The parent relationship is always preserved.

data.name: ParentRecordId_Description
data.value: Legacy hidden fallback. Do not bind this to a child-table text column; the parent ID is resolved from subgrid runtime context where available.

data.name: ParentEntityName_Description
data.value: Legacy hidden fallback for polymorphic parent lookups.
